svg.aria-label: Personal PDF Chatbot. Grounded RAG over your PDFs: per-page chunks, embeddings, MMR or hybrid retrieval, then a similarity gate. With evidence it generates a cited answer; without evidence it returns a fixed refusal without calling the model. An offline evaluation harness measures recall, faithfulness, citation validity and refusal accuracy.
